title: 1999 Delhi BMW hit-and-run case
narrative: FIR — 1999 Delhi BMW hit-and-run case, Lodhi Road, New Delhi. In the early hours of 10 January 1999, a speeding BMW driven by Sanjeev Nanda, returning from a party, ran over a police checkpoint at Lodhi Road, killing six people including CRPF constable Rajan Kumar and home guards Peru Lal and Ram Raj. Nanda, accompanied by Siddhartha Gupta and Manik Kapoor, fled the scene and the car was taken to a house in Golf Links to be cleaned. Inspector Jagdish Pandey traced the vehicle by following the oil leak. Nanda was convicted of culpable homicide not amounting to murder on 2 September 2008.
